metadata.title: Schwarz lemma on bounded symmetric domains endowed with holomorphic invariant Kähler--Berwald metrics
metadata.abstract: We prove a rigidity theorem: a globally symmetric complex Finsler space $(M, J, F)$ is necessarily a Kähler-Berwald space, namely $F$ must be a Kähler-Berwald metric. We also obtain a Schwarz lemma for holomorphic mappings $f$ from an arbitrary bounded symmetric domain $\mathfrak{D}$ into itself whenever $\mathfrak{D}$ is endowed with an $\mbox{Aut}(\mathfrak{D})$-invariant Kähler-Berwald metric $F$ such that its holomorphic sectional curvature is bounded below and above by negative constants $-K_1<0$ and $-K_2<0$, respectively. The novelty of this Schwarz lemma is that the Lu constant of $(\mathfrak{D},F)$ is optimal for each given $F$ whenever rank$(\mathfrak{D})\geq 2$.

analysis.topic: 黎曼、亚黎曼、Finsler及特殊几何结构
analysis.progressType: 复 Finsler 刚性与最优 Schwarz 界
analysis.workSummary: 证明全局对称复 Finsler 空间必为 Kähler–Berwald；在有界对称域的自同构不变 Kähler–Berwald 度量及负全纯截面曲率界下得到 Schwarz 引理，秩至少二时 Lu 常数最优。
analysis.breakthrough: 给出每个指定不变度量的最优收缩常数。
analysis.limitations: 需要对称性、不变性和双侧负曲率界。 当前为摘要级数学解读；AI 披露另行做独立全文核查，尚未核验的记录不代表未使用 AI。
